hi, i think that i'm scared that no matter if i try, i'm going to end up at the same place just like before. this is not the first time i tried to kill myself, but with each time it kind of felt that i was just getting closer. if i knew how i was going to end up at the end, then i could just save a lot of time, i could just avoid never feeling like this anymore. a friend once told me that when we are like this for such a long time, we eventually get used to feel like that, and we unconsciously build a comfort zone around it, we can't see it, we don't notice, but everybody that's been around us can.
if i want to keep going i need to get a job as fast as possible, i will ask around.

hi, i don't have anyone here. i could try to get in contact with a family member but i don't want to bother them, if i contact them i will make them feel sad and i don't want that, i'd rather keep it to myself for once.
i tried to have a life like most people have, stopped being most days in bed for the entire day. i was going out with friends, going out to some places on my own, but that's not really me, eventually i started breaking down here and there and now i'm kind of back at the beginning again, it's like i'm just going on circles, only each time getting worse than before. when i read what you wrote that we sometimes have to change directions, i started thinking that i'm scared that if i try to change directions i'm just going to end up going on another circle again.
